//: Constellation Harness — OpenCode port, sample project config.
//instructions: AGENTS.md carries the orchestrator policy (the static half of Claude Code's SessionStart hook). Listed explicitly for clarity; OpenCode loads AGENTS.md by default.
//plugin: The two hook plugins in .opencode/plugins/ are auto-loaded from that directory, so they do NOT need to be listed here. This array is only for npm-published plugins. Kept empty to show nothing extra is required.
//skills: Not configured here. OpenCode discovers skills from .opencode/skills/ AND directly from .claude/skills/ — so the harness's existing 25 SKILL.md files work UNCHANGED if the .claude/ tree is present, or copy them into .opencode/skills/.
//model: OpenCode is multi-provider; the harness's model tiers map to namespaced ids.
